scim_switch_staged: A switch to {provider} is staged. Complete or discard it first.
scim_change_in_progress: A change to the auth provider configuration is in progress. Wait for it to finish.
scim_already_provisions: {provider} already provisions users and groups through SCIM.
scim_other_connection: Another auth provider, {provider}, has the installation's only SCIM connection ({connection}).
scim_cleanup_pending: The groups of a deconfigured auth provider that shares {provider}'s group ID prefix are still being cleaned up ({cleanup}). Wait for the cleanup to finish.
scim_wrong_origin: {provider} was configured to provision users and groups through SCIM, so SCIM cannot be enabled for it.
scim_deletion_error: SCIM is enabled, but the groups that nothing references could not be deleted. Retry the deletion on Identity & Access → Auth Providers → SCIM before pushing groups from {provider}: a pushed group cannot bind to a referenced group while an unreferenced group has the same name.
scim_already_enabled: SCIM is already enabled for {provider}. Manage its token on Identity & Access → Auth Providers → SCIM.
scim_duplicate_enable: {count} referenced groups are named {name}, so a group pushed under that name binds to neither. Remove the references to all but one of them, and enabling SCIM deletes the others as unreferenced, or rename the group in {provider} so that the next sign-in of one of its members updates its name in Obot. References synced from Git must be changed at their source.
scim_already_enforced: SCIM is already enforced, and enforcement cannot be reversed
scim_not_configured: {provider} is not the configured auth provider.
scim_owner_required: Only an Owner who signed in through {provider} can enforce SCIM.
scim_owner_not_bootstrap: Only an Owner who signed in through {provider} can enforce SCIM. The bootstrap user cannot.
scim_unbound_group: The referenced group {group} has not been pushed from {provider}. Push it, renaming it there first if its name differs, or remove its references.
scim_everyone_warning: The group {group} cannot be pushed from {provider}. Replace its references with the all-users selector.
scim_missing_group_warning: {group} is referenced, but no {provider} group has this ID, so no pushed group can bind to it. Its references grant nothing.
scim_missing_group_references_warning: The group with ID {group} was removed but is still referenced by: {references}
scim_missing_group_profiles_warning: The group with ID {group} was removed but is still referenced by these vMCP profiles: {profiles}
scim_duplicate_warning: {count} referenced groups are named {name}, so a group pushed from {provider} under that name binds to neither. Remove the references to all but one of them, and then delete the unreferenced groups.
scim_namesake_warning: The unreferenced group {group} has the name of a referenced group, so a group pushed from {provider} under that name binds to neither. Delete the unreferenced groups.
scim_token_wrong_provider: {provider} is not the configured auth provider; SCIM tokens are issued only for the configured auth provider
scim_sign_in_to_enforce: Sign in through {provider} to enforce SCIM, so that you are known to be able to sign in once it is enforced.
scim_account_not_signed_in: {account} has not signed in through {provider}, so it is not known to be able to sign in once SCIM is enforced.
scim_account_unprovisioned: {account} has not been provisioned through SCIM. Assign yourself to the SCIM application in {provider}.
scim_account_deactivated: {account} is deactivated in {provider}, so you could not sign in once SCIM is enforced.
scim_deletion_in_progress: unreferenced groups are being deleted; try again once that finishes
scim_config_all_or_none: provide all of {parameters}, or none of them; missing: {missing}
scim_config_directory_required: {provider} synchronizes its directory at sign-in, so it requires {parameters}. Moving it to SCIM provisioning is a separate, reviewed step
scim_not_supported_parameters: {provider} does not support SCIM provisioning, so it needs every configuration parameter it requires
scim_connection_occupied: {provider} cannot provision users and groups through SCIM, because another auth provider has the installation's only SCIM connection ({connection})
scim_residual_data: {provider} still has group data from an earlier configuration, so it cannot be configured to provision users and groups through SCIM. Remove it by deconfiguring {provider}, which runs its auth provider cleanup, and configure it again once the cleanup finishes, or provide the directory credentials to synchronize its directory at sign-in instead.
scim_enable_owner_only: only an owner can enable SCIM
scim_provisioned_boolean: provisioned must be true or false
scim_enforce_owner_provider: only an owner who signed in through the auth provider can enforce SCIM
scim_delete_owner_only: only an owner can delete unreferenced groups
scim_token_owner_only: only an owner can manage the SCIM token
scim_cleanup_blocks_connection: auth provider cleanup {cleanup} is pending, so auth provider {provider} cannot have a SCIM connection until it finishes
